description: AddItem appends a new TODO item to a project and returns it with its id.

harness.description: harness is a preference such as "codex"; empty or "any" means none.

project.description: project is the heading to file the item under.

name: backlog_add_item

description: ListItems returns backlog items, optionally filtered by project, state and harness.

harness.description: harness keeps items this harness may run: its own plus "any"/unset.

state.description: state of UNSPECIFIED matches every state.

name: backlog_list_items

description: UpdateItem sets an item's state, claiming or releasing it.

claim.description: claim is required when state is CLAIMED.

by.description: by is "<sleeve>" or "<sleeve>/<harness>"; no whitespace or '@'.

id.description: id of the item to change.

state.description: state is the state to move the item to.

name: backlog_update_item

description: GetStatus returns the hub version, host platform and uptime.
name: hub_get_status

description: GetQuota returns the usage windows, resets and freshness of every provider subscription (Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, local LLMs).

refresh.description: refresh forces an immediate read of each provider, rate-limited per provider; providers read too recently keep their cached data.

name: quota_get_quota

description: CapturePane returns the current text of a session's active pane.

lines.description: Number of history lines above the visible screen to include.

name.description: name of the session to read.

name: session_capture_pane

description: CreateSession starts a detached tmux session running command, or the default shell when command is empty.

command.description: command is the argv to run; empty starts the default shell.

cwd.description: cwd is the starting directory; empty uses tmux's default.

env.description: env holds extra environment variables for the session.

name.description: name identifies the session; it must not already exist.

name: session_create_session

description: KillSession terminates a session and every process in it.

name.description: name of the session to kill.

name: session_kill_session
